```{ojs}
// Null model and sampling distribution of the sample mean
n = 30
mu0 = 200
sigma = 10
alpha = 0.05
standardError = sigma / Math.sqrt(n)
criticalValue = 1.959963984540054

viewof xbar_obs = Inputs.range(
  [mu0 - 4 * standardError, mu0 + 4 * standardError],
  {
    step: 0.05,
    value: mu0,
    label: md`Observed sample mean ${tex`\bar{x}_{\mathrm{obs}}`}`
  }
)

lower = mu0 - criticalValue * standardError
upper = mu0 + criticalValue * standardError
observedZ = (xbar_obs - mu0) / standardError

rvNormalCDF = (z) => {
  const sign = Math.sign(z);
  const x = Math.abs(z) / Math.sqrt(2);
  const t = 1 / (1 + 0.3275911 * x);
  const erf = sign * (1 - (((((1.061405429 * t - 1.453152027) * t + 1.421413741) * t - 0.284496736) * t + 0.254829592) * t * Math.exp(-x * x)));
  return 0.5 * (1 + erf);
}

pValue = Math.min(1, 2 * (1 - rvNormalCDF(Math.abs(observedZ))))
rejectNull = Math.abs(observedZ) > criticalValue

{
  const plotWidth = Math.min(700, Math.max(320, width));
  const step = standardError / 80;
  const xgrid = d3.range(mu0 - 4 * standardError, mu0 + 4 * standardError + step, step);
  const density = x => 1 / (standardError * Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI))
    * Math.exp(-0.5 * ((x - mu0) / standardError) ** 2);

  const plot = Plot.plot({
    width: plotWidth,
    height: 320,
    style: {
      background: "var(--plot-bg)",
      color: "var(--plot-fg)",
      fontFamily: bodyFont,
      fontSize: 14
    },
    x: {label: "Sample mean", domain: d3.extent(xgrid)},
    y: {label: "Density"},
    marks: [
      Plot.areaY(
        xgrid.map(x => ({x, y: (x < lower || x > upper) ? density(x) : 0})),
        {x: "x", y: "y", fill: "var(--plot-series-4)", fillOpacity: 0.28}
      ),
      Plot.line(
        xgrid.map(x => ({x, y: density(x)})),
        {x: "x", y: "y", stroke: "var(--plot-series-4)", strokeWidth: 2}
      ),
      Plot.ruleX([lower, upper], {stroke: "var(--plot-series-4)", strokeDasharray: "5,3"}),
      Plot.ruleX([xbar_obs], {stroke: "var(--plot-reference)", strokeWidth: 3}),
      Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "var(--plot-grid)"})
    ]
  });

  const status = html`<p role="status" aria-live="polite" style="margin:.5rem 0 0;">
    <strong>${rejectNull ? "Reject H₀" : "Fail to reject H₀"}.</strong>
    ${tex`z_{\mathrm{obs}}=${observedZ.toFixed(3)}`}; two-sided
    ${tex`p=${pValue.toFixed(4)}`}.
    The shaded tails form the 5% rejection region.
  </p>`;

  return html`<div style="max-width:700px;margin:0 auto;">${plot}${status}</div>`;
}
```
